tasks.short: Staple or tack advertising posters to surfaces

steps.what: Read the actual poster assignment and check the designated surface
Physically position and staple or tack the poster onto the designated surface

tasks.design: Keep assignment reading and physical poster attachment with the paperhanger. A native job view in {DOCS} can show the location, but it cannot position and fasten the actual poster, and no new completion record is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task is actual attachment to a physical surface.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing job documents already supply assignment information; no labour-removing change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Surface condition, positioning and secure physical attachment.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt handling to the actual poster and surface.
tasks.altitude: No change to physical posting responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: poster positioning and fastening remain physical work; a job view does not perform them.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe the actual attachment task and assignment reading. The work-planning process supplies location and poster identity before s1; those inputs are read rather than generated.

Before zero, record, report and send boundaries were inspected. The statement does not assign proof-of-posting photographs, a completion form or a client message. Do not invent such records. If they are actually required and performed by this paperhanger, add them and assess the native photo/job form before confirming this estimate.

Native job access and a template are assessed first. In this scenario the assignment is already directly available, so full reading and physical attachment remain; no repeated navigation or copied record baseline is assumed.
No implementation or recurring upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Whether this assignment includes actual proof-of-posting capture or a client completion send
research_questions: Observe posting and isolate any actual photo, record or send before confirming the physical-only estimate.

incremental.description: No new automation or recurring upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain all 10 assignment-reading and 90 physical-attachment points. An awkward fence or pole retains physical handling; no unobserved completion record creates a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Estimate material quantities from surfaces and work orders

steps.what: Measure actual surfaces and capture openings and relevant dimensions
Review the work order and enter verified measurements and material specifications
Calculate specified coverage, repeat allowances and required material quantities
Check practical allowances and record the actual material estimate

tasks.design: Test the native quantity calculator in the construction work-order module of {OPS_SYSTEM}. Calculate only from entered measurements and paperhanger-selected coverage/repeat assumptions, retaining actual measuring, specification entry and full practical estimate checking; no purchase is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coverage and roll calculations can be repeated manually after measuring.
tasks.enabler_now: Native quantity formulas using explicit dimensions and material specifications.
tasks.still_hard: Irregular surfaces, matching patterns and allowances that simple area arithmetic misses.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when nominal coverage understates the material needed for this surface.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated quantity arithmetic, with estimating responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native coverage calculators can apply specified dimensions and repeat rules; physical measurement and practical allowances remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe a site estimate combining actual measurements and work-order review. A work-order-only estimate removes and reweights physical measuring rather than claiming it saved.

s1 captures actual length, height, openings and units. The work order and supplier specifications provide material width, roll length and repeat; s2 verifies and manually enters these and selects the allowance rule. Missing dimensions or ambiguous repeats require human clarification.

Test native calculators first. Twenty-five removed points are actual repeated arithmetic and draft-estimate assembly, not measuring, selecting assumptions or existing calculator runtime. If arithmetic is already automatic, remove that baseline.

s4 is the task's actual quantity estimate, used to plan material needs, not an added activity record. Its complete check and ordinary author save are fully retained and ungated. Actual ordering, if assigned, requires its own final-version approval and separate send.
unknowns: Actual frequency of irregular surfaces and repeat-pattern exceptions
research_questions: Can a real estimate be reproduced exactly from captured dimensions and explicitly chosen repeat allowances?

incremental.description: Maintain material coverage and repeat-rule settings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25 arithmetic/assembly points less 1 upkeep gives 24. For irregular walls and complex repeat matching, retain bespoke layout and allowance work; only 6 points of rectangular-surface arithmetic disappear, giving 5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep physical posting and measurement human while reducing actual repeated material arithmetic.
skills_to_grow: Check calculator units and explicit repeat allowances
role.ambitious_version: Use verified arithmetic savings for closer surface and pattern-layout checks.
